grades.quote: An `sc` instruction instance in state Pending_mem_stores( _store_continuation_ ), that has not propagated its memory store operation, can always be made to fail.
grades.reason: Establishes that SC may fail before its store propagates, but does not explain its architectural return status.

grades.quote: An `sc` instruction instance in state Plain(Early_sc_fail( _res_continuation_ )) can always be made to fail. Action: update the state of to Plain( _res_continuation(false)_ ).
grades.reason: Describes an allowed early failure and its abstract false continuation, but not the SC.W destination-register status encoding.

grades.quote: RsrvNonEventual indicates that the operations are supported (the location is reservable), but without the eventual success guarantee described in the unprivileged ISA specification.
grades.reason: Explains that some regions support LR/SC without guaranteeing eventual success; it does not describe individual failure causes or return status.

grades.quote: _Note that these definitions permit an implementation to fail an SC instruction occasionally for any reason, provided the aforementioned guarantee is not violated._
grades.reason: Substantively explains permitted SC failures and constrained-loop progress guarantees, but does not explain what the returned status indicates.
